verdicts_or_reports.expected: On an indented list line '  - child', the unordered list action removes the existing marker (or at least doesn't add another)
verdicts_or_reports.observed: An additional '- ' is added each tap; the marker is not detected for indented items. Unindented '- item' toggles correctly.
steps: Text becomes '  - - child'; tap again gives '  - - - child'

verdicts_or_reports.expected: With 'Asterisk (*)' chosen as unordered list character, the toolbar inserts '* '
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Inserts '- ' regardless of the saved preference (dialog still shows Asterisk checked). Also the dialog title reads 'Theme' instead of the setting name.
steps: Settings > Edit Mode > Unordered list character > Asterisk (*)
Line becomes '- gamma' instead of '* gamma'

sign_off.notes: Filed 2 bugs: (1) the unordered list action doesn't detect markers on indented lines, so it adds extra '- ' each tap; (2) the unordered list character setting (Asterisk) is ignored by the toolbar, and its dialog title reads 'Theme'. Checked and found OK: sort menu options and persistence (Size, Reverse, Folder first), new-file dialog type list and extensions, ordered list, bold, heading, inline code and undo.
